en.headline: Health chief says drug and device regulator to be set up this year
en.dek: Lo Chung-mau said the new centre would support first-tier local approval of innovative medicines, with a target of full review capacity by 2030.
body: The Secretary for Health, Professor Lo Chung-mau, said Hong Kong would establish a Centre for Medical Products Regulation within this year to build a local first-tier system for approving innovative drugs and medical devices.

Speaking in an interview for the RTHK and Ta Kung Wen Wei Media Group programme Hong Kong and the 15th Five-Year Plan, Lo said the city could serve as a window for mainland innovative medicines to reach overseas markets and for international products to enter Hong Kong. He said the centre was intended, over time, to gain international recognition so that Hong Kong could both introduce quality products and help mainland products become better known abroad.

Lo said the government hoped the centre would be able to conduct a full review of innovative medicines by 2030. He also said Hong Kong had the scientific capacity to help set standards for Chinese medicines and to support their international use. Pharmaceutical companies quoted in the same programme said the Measure of Using HK and Macao Registered Drugs and Medical Devices in the Greater Bay Area made Hong Kong registration attractive because patients at designated Guangdong institutions come from across the country.

zh.headline: 盧寵茂：年內成立藥械監督管理中心 盼2030年全面審批新藥
zh.dek: 醫務衞生局局長接受專訪時表示，香港將於今年內成立藥物及醫療器械監督管理中心，目標2030年可全面審批創新藥物。
body: 醫務衞生局局長盧寵茂表示，香港將於今年內成立藥物及醫療器械監督管理中心，建立本地「第一層審批」制度，審批創新藥物及醫療器械。
盧寵茂接受港台與大公文匯傳媒集團聯合製作節目《港好十五五》訪問時指出，香港可發揮窗口作用，讓內地創新藥物借助本港與國際的聯繫「走出去」，同時把國際藥械「引進來」。他期望中心逐步獲得國際認可，既可引入優質產品，亦可讓國家藥械為更多地方認識。
他表示，期望到2030年中心可全面審批創新藥物。推動中醫藥方面，他指香港科研水平高，有能力和責任配合國家政策，建立中藥標準並推動中醫藥國際化。同節目引述藥企指，在「港澳藥械通」下，於香港研發和註冊的新藥械可在廣東省指定醫療機構使用，病人來自各地，對企業具吸引力。
